name: Ciudad Universitaria de Caracas
description: This is the main campus of the Central University of Venezuela, set in the middle of Caracas. Architect Carlos Raúl Villanueva spent about twenty years shaping it, and it is still the only 20th-century university campus by a single architect to win UNESCO recognition. Its covered walkways link faculties, an Olympic Stadium and the Aula Magna, where Alexander Calder's colourful "Clouds" hang from the ceiling.
